name: Urformen
line: Bauhaus-poster monumentality on bone and carbon in Jost: a Blossfeldt fern-frond photograph stands at full height beside the headline, and as you scroll it stays put, shrinks and settles into the third cell of a strict grid of three Blossfeldt plates, each carrying one of the core figures in its gutter; the explorers are carbon posters, each paired with a plant and four huge numerals.
notes: The flight is a small inline script (transform from measured positions) rather than kit data-progress, so the plant lands exactly on its cell; it runs only at 901px and wider with motion allowed. On tablets and phones, and with reduced motion or JavaScript off, the hero plant and the grid plate are both simply shown, so the fern appears twice in a row there. All five Blossfeldt plates are used once each and shown in black and white (the fern scan is brightened to match the others). Silver #9A9893 is decorative only (it fails AA for text); green #23372B is used for links only. Jost covers Cyrillic; Chinese falls back to system fonts.
